name: Etou Mitsuki
source:
"Shut up and stay here until I'm finished talking."

A picture-perfect tsundere. Despite his small stature, his speech and actions are unexpectedly dynamic and masculine.  The only tsukkomi in the Arts and Culture Department. He has a tendency to dress like a woman.

Image color: Red
Image flower: Camellia, higanbana
